newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Ten stocks fell, two rose and five were flat in 6.2-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday with the WIG 20 index flat at 1,463.7 points.
The remaining 13 stocks did not trade.
In comparison with their main-market fixing 10 stocks fell and seven rose.
NFI units fell 0.4 percent to 119.5 zlotys in a 3.4-million-zloty turnover
The National Investment Fund NFI index fell 1.4 percent to 120.8 points in 0.7-million-zloty trade.
